Callout.Name: Vehicle Failing to Stop
Callout.Message: Vehicle failed to stop for a patrol, last seen heading east.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle known to the caller, driver not identified.

Script.Line: It failed to stop about two minutes ago and it went east.
I did not get the driver. Only the vehicle.
I am not pursuing on my own. Not without authorisation.

Lines.Approach: They failed to stop and went east. Call it in before you do anything.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
